collision.basis: Clowe et al. (2006) give the places. Gas (Table 2): the main cluster's plasma at 06:58:30.2, -55:56:35.9 and the subcluster's at 06:58:21.2, -55:56:30.0 (J2000). Mass (Sect. III): the main peak 21.2 arcsec west and 17.7 north of the main cluster's southern brightest galaxy (06:58:35.3, -55:56:56.3) and the subcluster's 7.1 arcsec east and 6.5 north of its brightest galaxy (06:58:16.0, -55:56:35.1). Markevitch et al. (2002, Sect. 4.1) fit the gas about the bullet as round about the line it moves along, and Springel & Farrar (2007, Sect. V.1) find the cones of its bow shock and cold front round about that line, as a central collision gives; they and Clowe et al. fit the mass with two round halos. Barrena et al. (2002) put the line 5 to 15 degrees from the plane of the sky, from the subcluster's galaxies receding 616 km/s in the cluster's frame; Lage & Farrar (2014, Sect. 4.3) fit about 10 degrees, the subcluster receding.
